binding: Convergence re-bind audit for the post-merge head: the receipt binds the exact current English, context and Spanish bytes, proves key/ICU parity and the parent-union provenance, and carries forward only findings that are still true on these bytes. It is not a translation of anything.

references.path_note: Core guidance read in the shared core checkout; the three hashes match the es-extract-a815d841bd5d-r2 audit's references, so the guidance revision is unchanged since the parent audit.

limitations: Static catalogue audit only: no browser, build, install, heavy suite or rendered frame was produced; width checks are code-point arithmetic against the English context sidecar hints, not measured pixels.
No native-speaker sign-off is claimed; the catalogue values are the subject, and component call sites were read only to establish UI role and placeholder meaning.
No catalogue, context, generator, ledger or allowance file was edited by this run. The receipt is written under i18n/receipts/ for the implementer to bind.
scope: Full ui.chat.header namespace (12 keys; main's 10 plus new_chat and new_chat_with), read at PR #1403 head 0adbb37b94 against the English source and the en context sidecar.

findings.reason: The run-details overflow-menu labels materially exceed their advisory 20-cell budgets (28 and 27 cells, 1.65x/1.69x the English source) and Spanish runs long in menu labels. The finding is unchanged from the main-bytes audit and is carried so this re-bind does not silently drop it.
findings.evidence: Cerrar detalles de ejecución: 28/20 cells; Abrir detalles de ejecución: 27/20 cells. Shortened forms are 15 and 14 cells. No rendered menu was built in this pass, so clipping is a source-level risk, not an observed defect.
findings.carried_from: i18n/receipts/bf867ef95b69.json (ES-T1-02), same values at the current bytes; the es-final delta pass noted the same overruns as pre-existing advisory notes.

observations: conversation_name is 25/24 advisory cells; it is an accessible input name, not a visible menu label, and the prior pass judged it not a clipping defect.
new_chat and new_chat_with are inside their budgets and use the audited house noun chat; {target} is kept verbatim for an agent or team's own display name.
No value is identical to English; no straight quotes, double spaces, control characters or bidi controls were found.
method: Read the English source, its .context sidecar and the Spanish target from git objects (git show) at the PR head; no checkout or catalogue file was modified.
Compared key sets and order: es equals the English 12-key set in English order; main's 10 keys are all present and unchanged.
Parsed all 12 messages with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser 3.5.21 and compared argument/type trees with English: one argument in new_chat_with, preserved byte-exactly.
Checked byte hygiene: UTF-8, no BOM, LF only, trailing newline, no duplicate keys, tab-indented one-key-per-line JSON.
Checked widths against the context sidecar maxCells hints and code-point lengths; read register, idiom and glossary against the es style guide and programme glossary.
verdict: clean-with-findings — 12 keys read; 0 blocker, 0 major, 1 minor (carried ES-T1-02), 0 nit. Both added header titles are accurate, idiomatic and within budget; the two run-details labels retain their previously recorded advisory overrun.
